name: atlas
description: Source control for agents. Use multiple coding agents, track their changes and query them in one place
one_liner: A dashboard for managing several AI coding agents at once, so a developer running multiple Claude/Codex sessions in parallel can see and query what each one changed in one place.
buyer: A developer or small engineering team running several AI coding agents in parallel who currently loses track of what each agent touched across scattered terminal windows.
business_use_cases: A solo indie developer runs 3-4 parallel agents on different features and uses it to review diffs before merging.
A dev tooling startup could white-label it as the 'mission control' layer for their own multi-agent product.
An engineering team standardizes on it to audit what AI agents changed across the codebase over a sprint.

money_ideas.idea: A hosted team version with shared dashboards and audit logs for engineering managers overseeing multiple agent users.

steal_this: It's a dev tool for developers, not really a weekend consumer product — the honest move is contributing/extending it if you already run multi-agent workflows, not building a business on top.
